name: Queensland Rental Grant
summary: Help with rent to start a tenancy for low-income Queenslanders who are homeless or at risk of homelessness.
who: Meet the bond loan income, savings and residency rules
Meet at least one extra condition, such as being homeless or at risk of becoming homeless
how: Use the eligibility checker, or contact Housing Services on 13 QGOV (13 74 68)
catches: The page does not state the grant amount.

source.label: Queensland Government: Bond loan and rental grant eligibility

evidence.quote: You’re currently homeless or at risk of becoming homeless.
less than $5,500 in cash or savings among all the bond loan applicants
